name: Finger Pool
tagline: Flick a ball with your finger. Colours fly into the pockets. Take turns.
description:
A green table, fifteen coloured balls in a triangle, a white one waiting. Put your finger on a ball and flick — the faster you move, the harder it goes. Any ball. There is no stick and there are no rules: knock them in.

On your own it is that game, on this device. Two of you can pass the same screen. Or press Invite and a friend takes the next turn on their own phone or computer — there is no game server, no account, and no lobby. The room is the link. Each person keeps the balls they pocket.

An unofficial port of fingerPool by victorqribeiro. This copy adds a friend on a second device, and a score for whose balls went in.
